name: Q.E.
summary: Auction game where nations bid unlimited money for companies, but the biggest spender is eliminated before scoring.
rules_text: Players auction 15-16 Company Tiles one at a time. Each auction: the auctioneer reveals a company and posts a positive public opening bid. Other players write secret bids (any number including zero, but not equal to auctioneer's) and give them privately to the auctioneer. Highest bid wins the tile; the auctioneer writes the winning amount hidden on its back, unless the auctioneer won, then it stays public. Bidding zero (except in 3p) scores 2 VP once per round, where a round is each player having been auctioneer once. Ties are rebid up to three times. Auctioneer rotates left. After all tiles are sold, players tally VP from tile face values, zero-bid bonuses, matching own nation, industry monopolies (including a secret Industry Token), and diversification sets. Sum total spent from hidden backs; highest spender is eliminated (all ties eliminated). Among survivors, least spender gets bonus VP, most VP wins, tie-break by least spent.
rating_reason: Auction bidding game with hidden bids, bluffing, arithmetic scoring - fits engine.
